about: flute_vs_trombone: every first-time kit.music.note(name, midi, dur, cap, vel) call while kit.music.score() builds the soundtrack, in order. A note is synthesised once and cached by (name, int(midi), round(dur, 3), cap, round(vel, 2)); later calls with the same key reuse it and draw nothing

notes.order: the order is the order kit.music.score() first asks for each note: the bed and the fighters in the order score() calls them. The Studio must synthesise first-time notes in this order
notes.args: dur, cap and vel are the values passed (floats; `hex` has their float.hex()); the voice is called as pp_bridge.voice(name, int(midi), vel, dur), then cut or padded to int(cap * 48000) samples with a fade (kit.music.fit) and multiplied by the instrument's gain
notes.voice_calls: the pp_bridge.voice calls made inside the note, in order. "why": "note" is the note itself; "inst_gain" is the level-matching note kit.music.inst_gain synthesises the first time an instrument plays: voice(name, (lo + hi) // 2, 0.8, 0.2). It comes AFTER the note's own voice call, because Python evaluates fit(voice(...)) before inst_gain(name)
notes.draws: the n of each nz(n) call inside the voice call (the FLUTE draws one block per note; the TROMBONE draws none)
notes.noise: noise_before / noise_after: the generator's `state` as a decimal string (its `inc` never changes: generator.inc). noise_after of one row is noise_before of the next
notes.uses: how many times score() asked for this note in all
notes.sha256: SHA-256 of the note's float64 samples (little-endian); voice_calls[].sha256 of the voice output at 48 kHz before fit and gain
